The life sciences practice became Medicxi in February 2016 and its companies are outside the portfolio on this page (decisions.md D3).

founding_year.basis: 'Index Ventures was officially founded in Geneva in 1996 by Neil Rimer, David Rimer and Giuseppe Zocco' (Wikipedia, read 2026-10-06); the firm's own post of 2026-07-31 is titled '30 Years In'. Its roots are older: Index Securities, a Geneva bond trading firm founded by Gerald Rimer in 1976, and the investments its team made before the first fund (decisions.md R2).

history.value: Index Ventures was founded in Geneva in 1996 by Neil Rimer, David Rimer and Giuseppe Zocco, out of a family bond trading firm. It became known for early bets on Skype, MySQL, Dropbox, Adyen, Figma, Revolut and Wiz, and opened offices in London in 2002, San Francisco in 2011 and New York in 2022. In July 2026 it announced new seed, venture and growth funds that bring its investing capital to $3.5 billion.
history.basis: founding, founders and the bond trading firm: Wikipedia (read 2026-10-06) and the firm's post '30 Years In' (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/30-years-in-perfecting-our-craft/); offices: 'Danny Rimer, who opened Index's London office in 2002 and its San Francisco base in 2011' (the firm's post of 2016-02-03, https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/index-ventures-announces-new-partners-and-125b-to-back-seed-venture-and-growth-stage/) and the New York announcement of 2022-05-05 (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/index-ny-announcing-our-new-office/); the named bets are portfolio companies on this page; 2026 funds: 'bringing our total investing capital to $3.5 billion across all stages', a $400 million seed fund, a $900 million venture fund and a growth fund raised to $2.2 billion (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/30-years-in-perfecting-our-craft/). Moved here from the page: the fund ladder; the life sciences practice that became Medicxi in 2016 and is not part of the portfolio shown; the firm's own count of 2024, '108 Index-backed startups ... reach a $1 billion valuation, 23 have surpassed a $10 billion valuation, and 57 went on to be publicly traded' (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/relationships-that-reshape-industries-index-launches-23bn-in-new-funds/).

Published inside quotation marks, as the firm's own words (Erik, 2026-09-26).

investment_geo.basis: the firm's own words: 'from SF to NY, London to Tel Aviv' (homepage meta description) and 'offices in San Francisco, London, and New York, plus partners on the ground in Berlin and Tel Aviv' (post of 2024-07-10); the list's own region filter is Europe and North America. Core Europe and US (two-label cap), other Israel; the landed country distribution is restated in report.md

investment_scope.basis: focus from the firm's own site sector tags on 351 base rows, crosswalked to data/taxonomy/focus.json (crosswalk in config.json), published above 15 companies. Scope type is the curated judgement carried in investor.json.

investment_range.basis: median: $17.2M, the median of the earliest sized round that each of 258 portfolio companies' records tie the firm to (the firm's own posts and archived news, company releases and press; rows in scratch/entry-round-sizes.json; by stage Seed $6.0M over 87, Series A $16.2M over 96, Growth $45.0M over 75). It is a round size, not a cheque size. lower: documented seed entries of $1.3M to $1.5M (GroupSpaces 2010, Productboard 2016, Geckoboard 2012); upper: the $300M round the firm led in DeepL (its post of 2024-05-22)

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24). Considered next: Revolut, Robinhood, Figma, Facebook (a late secondary purchase), Etsy, Deliveroo, Anthropic.

aum.basis: both ends: the sworn Form ADV Section 7.B(1) gross asset values of the firm's exempt reporting adviser, Index Ventures SA, CRD 161175, annual amendment of 2026-03-31 (IAPD PDF parsed with pypdf, sources/registers/adv-7b-funds.json): 32 private funds, $25,321,111,008 in all. An exempt reporting adviser files no Item 5.F, so the 7.B composite is the sworn figure (Creandum precedent). It includes Index Ventures Life VI ($211,570,819), whose companies are outside the portfolio on this page (decisions.md D3), and predates the funds of July 2026. Medicxi's adviser (CRD 283504) is a separate firm and is not counted. Wikipedia gives EUR 11.7 billion (2025); the firm's posts state capital raised, not assets. Both belong here, not in the range.

funds.basis: sizes from the firm's own announcements: XIII $900M, Origin III $400M and Growth VII raised from $1.5B to $2.2B (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/30-years-in-perfecting-our-craft/); XII $800M and Growth VII $1.5B (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/relationships-that-reshape-industries-index-launches-23bn-in-new-funds/); XI $900M, Growth VI $2bn and Origin I $200M (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/index-raises-31-billion-to-support-new-wave-of-founders-everywhere/); Origin II $300M (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/announcing-index-origin-ii-a-300-million-seed-fund-designed-for-extraordinary-entrepreneurs/); VIII $550M and Growth III $700M (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/index-ventures-announces-new-partners-and-125b-to-back-seed-venture-and-growth-stage/); the $2bn of 2020 (https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/index-ventures-announces-2bn-new-funds-support-emerging-entrepreneurs/) splits into X $800M and Growth V $1.2B, and the $1.65B of 2018 into IX $650M and Growth IV $1B (TechCrunch, https://techcrunch.com/2020/04/09/index-raises-1-2b-growth-fund-and-800m-to-invest-in-emerging-startups and https://techcrunch.com/2018/07/09/index-ventures-closes-2-funds-1b-for-growth-rounds-and-650m-for-early-stage-investing); VII EUR 400M in June 2014 (Globes, 'Index Ventures raises $550m fund'; EUR 400.0M @ ECB 2014-06-11 = $541.9M); VI EUR 350M (the firm's own news item of 2012-06-18, https://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2013-48-index?url=http%3A%2F%2Findexventures.com%2Fnews%2Findex%2Fnews_id%2F327&output=json; @ ECB 2012-06-18 = $441.6M); V EUR 350M (the firm's own news item of 2009-03-03, https://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2012-index?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.indexventures.com%2Fnews%2Findex%2Fnews_id%2F210&output=json; @ ECB 2009-03-03 = $441.5M). No entry carries an accession: the funds file Form D at first close. Not listed, because no size was confirmed in this run: Index Ventures I to IV (1996 to 2007), Growth I (2008) and Growth II (2011). Counted here, not listed: the parallel and entrepreneur funds beside each main fund, Index SPV I and II, the Yucca co-investment vehicles, and Index Ventures Life VI (2012), the life sciences fund now sub-advised by Medicxi.

hq_location.basis: Judged override of the automated reading (San Francisco, CA, site_list): the site-list rule publishes the first office in page order, and the contact page orders the offices San Francisco, London, New York; page order is not a statement about where the firm operates, and it put the smaller office first. The firm's own team page (https://www.indexventures.com/team) files 22 of its 49 people under London, against 14 under San Francisco and 10 under New York, among them 11 of its 26 investors; London is the firm's oldest operating office after Geneva ('Danny Rimer, who opened Index's London office in 2002', the firm's post of 2016-02-03). Ruled by Erik, 2026-10-06: 'make london HQ'. The Form ADV principal office is 2 Rue De Jargonnant, Geneva, Switzerland (INDEX VENTURES SA, CRD 161175, Annual Amendment filed 2026-03-31). Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.
